translation: （队伍中重新出发的退隐角色不受影响。）

text: Select a category below to begin.
translation: 选择下方类别以开始浏览。

text: Chosen mode is only available in worlds with developed religions.  There are no temples available.  Try an older world.
translation: 天选者模式需要宗教已发展的世界。目前没有可用神殿，请尝试历史更悠久的世界。

text: For adventure.  Information and followers are easier to obtain, and a compass guides you.
translation: 适合冒险。更容易获得情报与招募追随者，并有罗盘指引方向。

text: For the most freedom.  All features are accessible but you'll receive no direction.
translation: 自由度最高。可使用所有功能，但不会提供方向指引。

text: Difficulty only affects starting skills and equipment.
translation: 难度只影响初始技能与装备。

text: You are a newly-minted hearthperson of the great {ADV_LEADER} in {ADV_SITE}, a {ADV_SITE_KIND}.  Destiny is calling!
translation: 你刚成为伟大的{ADV_LEADER}的侍卫，居于{ADV_SITE}（{ADV_SITE_KIND}）。命运正在呼唤你！

text: You are a {ADV_JOB} in {ADV_SITE}, a {ADV_SITE_KIND}, and you have never strayed far from home.
All of your progress since the last save will be lost.
translation: 上次储存之后的所有进度都会遗失。

text: This is the squad menu. Here you can create squads, fill their positions, assign equipment and schedules, and give specific orders.[B]It is recommended that you prepare a squad and get them training as soon as you can. You have no idea what's lurking out there.
translation: 这是小队选单。你可以在这里建立小队、安排成员、指派装备与排程，并下达具体指令。[B]建议尽早建立小队并开始训练。你无法预料外头潜伏着什么危险。

text: Here you can view your nobles, as well as assign your administrators, military leaders, and other officials.[B][C:5:0:0]Militia Commanders[C:7:0:0] are assigned here. Once the first leader is assigned, subsequent [C:5:0:0]Captain[C:7:0:0] positions will appear. These can also be assigned from the squad menu.[B]Certain important functions in your fortress can only be performed by assigned administrators, such as the [C:5:0:0]Manager[C:7:0:0] and [C:5:0:0]Bookkeeper[C:7:0:0]. Once they are assigned, you can create work orders, run a [C:1:0:1]Hospital[C:7:0:0], and count and appraise your hoard.[B]Nobles and certain administrators require rooms, and some may also make demands.
translation: 你可以在这里查看贵族，并任命行政人员、军事领袖与其他官员。[B][C:5:0:0]军事指挥官[C:7:0:0]在这里任命。任命首位指挥官后，就会出现后续的[C:5:0:0]小队长[C:7:0:0]职位。你也可以在小队选单任命这些职位。[B]要塞的某些重要功能必须由已任命的行政人员执行，例如[C:5:0:0]经理人[C:7:0:0]与[C:5:0:0]簿记员[C:7:0:0]。任命之后，你便能建立工作命令、经营[C:1:0:1]医院[C:7:0:0]，并清点与估价库存。[B]贵族与部分行政人员需要房间，其中有些人也会提出要求。
